newsFlag.summary: Juszczyk is managing a finger injury sustained in early August but returned to full practice participation on Wednesday after taking Tuesday off for rest.
Undisclosed
Personal

Evans (groin) returned to practice Wednesday after missing significant time with various nagging injuries but should be available for the season opener against the Rams next Thursday as long as he avoids setbacks.
Marcus Mariota is returning to practice after missing two weeks with a sprained MCL in his right knee suffered on Aug. 14, and will work to increase his workload as the Commanders' backup QB.
Undisclosed
McCaffrey participated fully in practice drills including running and catching passes, showing positive progress with an undisclosed injury ahead of Week 1.

Kittle is trending toward playing in Week 1 after tearing his Achilles in January and traveling with the team to Australia, but a final decision won't be made until arrival and his snaps may be limited if cleared.
Aaron Jones is active and co-starting for the Vikings, but his age (31) and injury history present elevated fantasy risk compared to co-back Jordan Mason.
Deshaun Watson named Browns starting QB after winning competition with Shedeur Sanders, though he has a history of significant injuries including Achilles tendon issues that kept him out all of 2025.
James Conner has been placed on injured reserve with a designation to return due to ongoing foot injury complications, requiring him to miss at least the first four games of the season.
Mitchell Trubisky is dealing with a biceps injury that caused him to miss Wednesday's practice, but the issue is considered minor and he remains day-to-day.
Mahomes is on track to start Week 1 despite recovering from a torn left ACL sustained last December, with confidence growing that he will be available for the 2026 season opener.
Alvin Kamara sustained an MCL sprain and is expected to be out for at least one month, putting his Week 1 availability in jeopardy and making him a candidate to open the season on injured reserve.
McNichols was placed on injured reserve with a quadriceps injury and cannot return until at least Week 5, making him unavailable for fantasy purposes in the immediate future.
Ray-Ray McCloud was placed on injured reserve by the Bears with an undisclosed injury and is expected to miss the entire 2026 season.
Christian Kirk was placed on injured reserve with a calf injury and must miss at least four games to start the season.
Moore suffered an ankle injury in a preseason game but has returned to practice and is expected to be available for Week 1 against the Texans.
Jakobi Meyers (hand) is returning to practice Wednesday after a two-week absence and is expected to be available for Week 1 against the Browns.

Justice Hill is healthy heading into the 2026 season after an injury-shortened 2025 campaign, though his role as the No. 2 running back behind Derrick Henry may be subject to change under the new coaching staff.
D.J. Montgomery was placed on injured reserve by the Colts due to an abdominal injury and is expected to miss the entire 2026 season unless he reaches an injury settlement.
Devin Singletary is not in uniform for Friday's preseason game against the Jets, though this appears to be a rest decision rather than an injury concern.
Undisclosed
David Sills was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and cannot return before Week 5.
Ty Johnson remains sidelined with a lower leg injury but has resumed running and sprinting, with limited fantasy relevance due to his backup role behind James Cook and Ray Davis.
Undisclosed
DK Metcalf dealt with an undisclosed injury during training camp but returned to practice and is expected to be ready for Week 1 against the Falcons.
Achilles
Josh Jacobs was placed on the Commissioner's Exempt List due to misdemeanor charges from a domestic incident and is ineligible to practice or play while on the list.
J.K. Dobbins is on track to play Week 1 after being held out of preseason due to a soft-tissue injury that appears to be fully resolved.
Tagovailoa is actively playing in preseason games and remains healthy, though his Week 1 starting status is uncertain due to competition with Michael Penix Jr.
Pittman is expected to be ready for Week 1 after missing training camp and preseason time with a hamstring injury, but has returned to practice and will have time to ramp up before the opener.
AJ Dillon is active and played in the preseason game, but could see increased role if injuries to Hubbard and Etienne persist into Week 1.
Jerry Jeudy will not play in the Browns' preseason game against the Bills, though he remains active and played in the previous preseason game.
Tee Higgins is dealing with a bruised heel and did not participate in practice Wednesday, putting his Week 1 availability against Tampa Bay in question.
Chuba Hubbard returned to practice Tuesday while recovering from a mid-August hamstring injury and is trending positively toward season availability.
Waddle played in preseason and looked unencumbered by earlier leg muscle tightness, though his game action may be limited before Week 1.
Hamstring
Jermar Jefferson was reverted to the Vikings' injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 regular season.
Brock Wright is active and caught a pass in the preseason, with potential starting role if Sam LaPorta's hip injury sidelines the primary tight end.
Ben Skowronek suffered a concussion in Thursday's preseason game and must clear the NFL's five-step concussion protocol with independent neurologist clearance before being eligible to play in Week 1.
Ja'Marr Chase hyperextended his left knee at practice last week and did not participate in drills at Wednesday's practice, leaving his Week 1 availability uncertain.
Trevor Lawrence is sitting out Friday's preseason game against the Panthers as part of planned rest management ahead of Week 1.
Trey Sermon was placed on injured reserve by the Falcons with an undisclosed injury and is ineligible to play in 2026 unless waived with an injury settlement.
Knee
Cole Turner was placed on the Dolphins' injured reserve list with an undisclosed injury and will need to reach a settlement with Miami to have any chance of playing in 2026.
Grant Calcaterra was placed on injured reserve with a back injury and designated to return, sidelining him until at least Week 5.
Melton is active and healthy but faces roster uncertainty due to poor preseason performance and competition for his special teams role.
Irvin Charles was placed on injured reserve with a designation to return due to an undisclosed preseason injury and will miss at least the first four regular season games.
Isiah Pacheco was placed on injured reserve with a back issue and will miss at least the first four games, with no clear timetable for return.
Cameron Dicker is working through a minor issue but head coach Jim Harbaugh is not concerned and he is expected to be ready for Week 1 against Arizona.
Rachaad White is sidelined with a hamstring injury sustained Aug. 19 and will miss the Commanders' final two preseason games, though he is making progress with individual drills.
Khalil Shakir has been sidelined with an undisclosed injury since preseason Week 1 but there is optimism he will be available for Week 1 against the Texans.
Ty Chandler suffered a season-ending knee injury during a preseason game and has been placed on injured reserve, missing the entire 2026 season.
Chris Oladokun was placed on the Chiefs' injured reserve list with an undisclosed injury and is expected to miss the entire 2026 regular season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Skylar Thompson has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Brittain Brown was placed on injured reserve by the Bears with an undisclosed injury and is expected to miss the entire season.
Groin
Metchie is active and participated in preseason action, though he has a history of injury issues and is competing for a roster spot on the Panthers.
Alec Pierce is recovering from offseason ankle surgery and missed most of training camp and preseason action, but the Colts hope he will play in Week 1 against the Ravens.
Calvin Austin III was placed on injured reserve after suffering a torn ACL and will miss the entire 2026 season.
Robinson took a hard hit during joint practice and underwent concussion testing which ruled out a concussion, with early indications positive for Week 1 availability.

Breece Hall is recovering from a minor groin strain suffered last Monday and participated in agility drills on the side, appearing ahead of schedule in his recovery with Week 1 as the target return date.
Cade Otton returned to practice Tuesday after missing about a week with an undisclosed injury, though his status for the preseason finale remains unclear.
Will Mallory was placed on injured reserve with a thumb injury and will miss at least the first four games of the 2026 regular season, with earliest return in Week 5.
Keaton Mitchell is missing practice due to an undisclosed injury but is working with trainers and is expected to play in Week 1.
Johnston missed some practice time with a lower-body injury suffered during joint practice with the 49ers but looked fully healthy in preseason action, catching a 65-yard touchdown.
Kendre Miller sustained a minor injury at Tuesday's practice but is expected to be available for Week 1 if he recovers fully.
Tank Bigsby missed Monday's practice due to a toe injury but is expected to participate fully in Wednesday's practice after likely sitting out for maintenance.
Undisclosed
Scott Matlock was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss at least the first four weeks of the 2026 season, with earliest return in Week 5.
Brayden Willis is in the NFL's concussion protocol after suffering a concussion in the preseason finale and must be cleared by an independent neurologist before becoming available.
Tyrell Shavers was placed on the reserve/PUP list while recovering from a torn ACL and will miss at least the first four weeks of the regular season, with earliest return in Week 5.
Knee
Princeton Fant has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Jake Bobo suffered a serious knee injury during a joint practice with the Titans and was placed on injured reserve, ruling him out for the entire 2026 season.
Nate Adkins returned to practice Monday after briefly leaving Friday's session with a trainer, suggesting the injury was minor.
Emanuel Wilson has been designated as Questionable for upcoming availability.
Ben Sims was placed on injured reserve by the Dolphins with an undisclosed injury and must miss at least four games, though he may reach an injury settlement to sign elsewhere once healthy.
Sean Tucker missed Wednesday practice with a minor undisclosed injury but is expected to be available for Week 1 against the Bengals.
Marvin Mims Jr. missed Monday practice due to a bruised foot suffered in the preseason finale but has two weeks to recover before the regular season opener.
Tank Dell remains on injured reserve with a knee injury and must miss at least the first four games, though the GM indicated he is progressing and getting closer to a return.
Tucker Kraft is expected to be 'full go' for Week 1 after recovering from a torn ACL sustained 10 months prior, though he remains in early stages of return from a significant injury.
Josh Downs participated in Tuesday's practice after missing time with a minor calf injury and is expected to be off the injury report for Week 1.
Zay Flowers is dealing with a minor lower-body issue that kept him out of Wednesday's practice, but he ran sprints on the sideline and is expected to practice fully next week and play in Week 1.
Sam LaPorta returned to practice Tuesday after a hip injury with over two weeks to recover before the regular-season opener.

Rashee Rice returned to game action in a preseason game after recovering from a December concussion and is expected to be the Chiefs' top WR for Week 1, though he had a minor knee procedure during the offseason.
Davis Allen is recovering from a quadriceps injury and participated in limited practice Monday, with expectations he will be available for the regular-season opener.
Puka Nacua (groin) is ramping up gradually in practice ahead of Week 1, working off to the side during team drills after missing significant time during the summer.

Luke Musgrave was placed on the PUP list and will miss at least the first four weeks of the 2026 season due to a neck injury sustained during June minicamp, with an uncertain return timeline even after Week 5 eligibility.
Jayden Reed is being rested for Friday's preseason game in Denver as a precautionary measure after briefly missing practice time earlier in the month, but remains healthy and available.
Zach Charbonnet suffered an ACL tear in his left knee on Jan. 17 and will miss at least the first four games of the season.
Johnny Wilson was placed on injured reserve due to a knee injury and will miss the entire upcoming season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Chris Collier was placed on injured reserve by the Raiders with an undisclosed injury and is expected to miss the entire 2026 season unless an injury settlement is reached.
Undisclosed
Malik Nabers (knee) is progressing through practice participation after expressing uncertainty about his availability for the season opener, with his official Week 1 injury designation still pending.
Xavier Legette sustained an ankle injury during Wednesday's joint practice and will remain in a walking boot until Thursday, likely causing him to miss Friday's preseason finale against the Texans.
Coach Canales is optimistic Brooks will be available for Week 1 despite soreness, but he's been limited in practice and his exact injury location is unclear.
Isaac Guerendo was placed on the reserve/PUP list due to a pectoral injury and will miss at least the first four weeks of the season.
Groin
Jamari Thrash has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Tracy suffered a neck stinger in the preseason finale and is practicing in a non-contact jersey, with his availability status uncertain.
Hamstring
Carter Bradley suffered a thumb injury in the final preseason game and has been placed on injured reserve, likely sidelining him for the entire 2026 season.
British Brooks returned to practice Monday after undergoing hand surgery in early August and a three-week absence, and is working to be ready for Friday's preseason finale.
Mason Tipton was placed on the reserve/PUP list following tibia surgery and will miss at least the first four games of the regular season, with earliest return in Week 5.
Undisclosed
Jeshaun Jones received a three-game NFL suspension for violating the substance-abuse policy and will be ineligible for game action until Week 4.
Tip Reiman was moved to the reserve/PUP list due to an ankle injury and must miss at least four games before becoming eligible to return.
Braelon Allen started at RB in place of injured Breece Hall and is the team's top available RB, though he faces potential competition from Isaiah Davis once healthy.

Isaiah Davis is recovering from a knee injury sustained in early August training camp, did not participate in Wednesday's practice, and his availability for the Jets' regular-season opener remains uncertain pending practice participation next week.
MarShawn Lloyd is active and positioned as the top available option in the Packers backfield with Josh Jacobs sidelined, presenting both opportunity and uncertainty due to his limited experience.
Erick All passed his conditioning test and is cleared to participate in training camp after undergoing multiple knee surgeries for an ACL injury during the 2025 season.
Theo Johnson is participating in practice in a non-contact jersey after a shoulder injury but appears on track to play in Week 1 against the Cowboys.
McMillan remains sidelined with a knee injury at Tuesday's practice but there is optimism about his availability for Week 1 against the Bengals in 12 days.
Keon Coleman is recovering from a right foot/toe sprain suffered in the preseason opener and has returned to practice drills, with nearly two weeks remaining before Week 1.
Undisclosed
Jayden Daniels is active and returning from a previous elbow injury, playing limited snaps in preseason as part of his gradual comeback.
Ben Sinnott is dealing with an oblique injury and will miss Friday's preseason finale, but his availability for the season opener on Sept. 13 is not considered in peril.
Knee - PCL
Penix is recovering from a torn ACL and while cleared for team drills, he's been ruled out of Friday's preseason game but hopes to be available for Week 1 against the Steelers.
Trey Benson reverted to the Cardinals' injured reserve list due to ongoing knee troubles from a meniscus injury that required October surgery, and was unable to stay healthy on the practice field.
Thomas Yassmin was reverted to injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 season unless he reaches a settlement with the Packers.
Savion Williams is recovering from a high-ankle sprain on injured reserve and is expected to be eligible to return in Week 5 (debut Oct. 11 vs Bears).
Tyler Loop is expected to handle Week 1 kicking duties for Baltimore despite recent missed field goals and competition from Jake Moody on the practice squad, putting him on a short leash.
Jimmy Holiday was placed on injured reserve by the Chiefs with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 season unless he reaches an injury settlement.
Ashton Jeanty suffered a low-ankle sprain on Aug. 23 and hasn't practiced this week, but the coaching staff and GM are optimistic he will be ready for Week 1 against the Dolphins.
Tyler Warren (adductor strain) participated in Tuesday's practice and is expected to operate without restrictions for Week 1 against the Ravens.
Egbuka (toe) is progressing well in his recovery, running without obvious issues on the side field Wednesday, and is expected to be near full health by Week 1 in 11 days.
Jayden Higgins was placed on injured reserve after suffering a torn ACL in practice and will miss the entire 2026 season.
Hamstring
Ayomanor exited Thursday's practice early with a left shoulder issue but is practicing Friday and avoided a serious injury.
Jordan James returned from a rib fracture to play in the preseason game and showed promising performance as both a rusher and receiver, though limited preseason action may warrant monitoring.

Gordon is practicing in a non-contact jersey Wednesday after suffering a rib injury in the Dolphins' second preseason game, but his participation in practice suggests he is progressing toward availability.
Devin Neal was placed on injured reserve due to a hamstring injury sustained during preseason and will remain sidelined for the entire 2026 regular season unless waived.
Will Howard suffered a concussion during preseason and is in the NFL's five-step concussion protocol, requiring evaluation by an independent neurologist before returning to full contact practice.
Knee - ACL
Kyle Monangai is recovering from a right knee hyperextension suffered on Aug. 16 and remains week-to-week, though he showed positive progress running on Wednesday.
Johnson returned to action in preseason after missing two games due to an Aug. 4 groin strain, catching one pass on three targets.
Coach Liam Coen indicated LeQuint Allen Jr. is a game-time decision for Week 1 against the Browns with an undisclosed injury, suggesting he is unlikely to play Sunday.
Caleb Lohner was placed on injured reserve with a lower-body injury and will miss at least the first four games of the 2026 regular season, with earliest return in Week 5.

Croskey-Merritt missed the final two preseason games due to a lower-body injury and will not practice Monday, but is expected to return to practice next week with his participation level to be determined before the regular-season opener against the Eagles.
Moliki Matavao was placed on injured reserve due to a knee injury sustained in preseason and will miss the entire 2026 regular season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Jacoby Jones was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and is expected to miss the entire 2026 regular season unless he reaches a settlement with the Commanders.
Undisclosed
Coleman Owen was placed on injured reserve due to a concussion suffered during the preseason finale and will miss the entire season unless he reaches an injury settlement with the Colts.
Beaux Collins was placed on injured reserve with a designation to return, requiring him to miss at least the first four weeks of the regular season due to an undisclosed injury.
Carter Runyon was placed on injured reserve by the Raiders with an undisclosed injury and is ineligible to return until Week 5.
Dontae Fleming was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 regular season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Undisclosed
Undisclosed
Corey Kiner was traded to the Patriots and is active, positioned as the No. 3 running back behind Rhamondre Stevenson and TreVeyon Henderson (ankle).
Undisclosed
Arm
Dont'e Thornton Jr. was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and must miss at least the first four games of the 2025 regular season.
Ribs
Dalevon Campbell was placed on injured reserve with a significant leg injury sustained during Thursday's practice and will miss the entire 2026 regular season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Trevor Etienne was placed on injured reserve with an ankle injury suffered in the preseason finale and will miss at least four games.
Tory Horton has been sidelined with an undisclosed injury for over a week, but head coach Mike Macdonald indicated it is not a long-term or significant injury.
Robbie Ouzts has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Hampton is active and serving as the Chargers' lead back after missing time last season with a fractured left ankle, though he saw limited preseason action.
Dillon Gabriel was placed on injured reserve to start the 2026 season with a non-serious back injury, requiring him to miss at least the first four games.
Bhayshul Tuten did not practice Wednesday due to illness but is expected to be healthy by Week 1 against the Browns.
Tre Harris missed the last two preseason games with an undisclosed injury but is not expected to miss the regular-season opener.
TreVeyon Henderson is dealing with a right ankle injury, hasn't been cleared for full participation in practice, and is listed as questionable for Week 1 against the Seahawks.

Burden is recovering from a groin injury suffered in early August and has been cleared to participate in practice, but his availability for the Week 1 opener remains uncertain after missing the entire preseason.
Terrance Ferguson is dealing with soreness but was able to participate in limited practice activities, indicating he is likely day-to-day with a minor injury.
Isaiah Bond is listed as questionable for upcoming games.

Judkins missed preseason games due to an undisclosed injury but has returned to practice and appears to be past the issue, though limited preseason action warrants slight caution heading into the regular season.
Carson Towt has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Makai Lemon made his pro debut after overcoming a hamstring injury and is expected to assume the No. 3 receiver role for Week 1.

Sarratt is healthy and active but faces significant roster competition and may struggle to make the 53-man roster given his lackluster preseason performance compared to other receivers on the depth chart.
Adam Randall was placed on injured reserve by the Ravens with a designation to return due to an undisclosed injury and will miss at least the first four games of the 2026 regular season.
Jaren Kanak has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Dominic Richardson was placed on injured reserve by the Jets with an undisclosed injury and will need to reach an injury settlement to have a chance to play in 2026.
DJ Rogers, a tight end, suffered an MCL sprain during preseason and has been placed on injured reserve for the entire 2026 regular season.
Jeff Caldwell hyperextended his left knee during practice and was placed on injured reserve, sidelining him for the entire 2026 regular season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Knee
EJ Smith was placed on injured reserve Monday with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 regular season unless waived with injury settlement.
Chase Roberts reverted to Raiders IR with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 season unless he reaches a settlement with Las Vegas.
Undisclosed

Jeremiyah Love is recovering from a high-ankle sprain suffered in preseason Week 1 and was not suited up for Tuesday's practice, though he is progressing toward availability for the Week 1 regular-season opener.
Jordyn Tyson was placed on injured reserve with a right hamstring injury expected to sideline him for approximately two months, requiring him to miss at least the first four games of the season.
Kenyon Sadiq is on track to play Week 1 despite a hernia that caused him to miss training camp and preseason, but he will have a limited role as he ramps up activity over the next 10 days.
Shoulder
Oscar Delp is nursing a hamstring injury at Saints training camp with unclear severity, though he has time to recover before the preseason finale.
Ted Hurst III is active and competing for playing time, but his Week 1 availability depends on the health status of three injured Buccaneers wide receivers (Egbuka, McMillan, and Johnson).
Joe Royer was placed on the reserve/non-football illness list and must miss at least the first four weeks of the regular season due to a personal issue.
Kaytron Allen is expected to be the third-string running back to start the regular season, but could see increased workload if injuries to Croskey-Merritt or White persist into Week 1.
Undisclosed
Carsen Ryan returned to action in Thursday's preseason game after exiting Tuesday's practice early with a foot injury, catching both targets for nine yards.
Haynes King suffered a hamstring injury in the Hall of Fame Game and will miss the final three preseason games, putting his spot on the 53-man roster in jeopardy.
Undisclosed
Hayden Large was placed on injured reserve by the Bears with an undisclosed injury and must miss at least four regular-season games before becoming eligible to return.
Quentin Moore, a tight end, has been placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 regular season unless waived with an injury settlement.

Matthew Caldwell was placed on injured reserve by the Rams on Saturday due to an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire upcoming season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Carnell Tate missed Tuesday's practice due to stiffness but is expected to be available for Week 1 with no indication his status is in danger.

Eli Stowers is dealing with a hamstring injury and may not be active on gamedays even upon return, with limited offensive opportunities behind multiple tight ends on the Eagles depth chart.
Price is healthy and recovered from his lower-body injury but will sit out the preseason finale as a precautionary measure, though he is expected to play a key role in Seattle's backfield in Week 1.
Kacmarek is week-to-week with an undisclosed injury and missed the preseason finale, putting his availability for the regular season in question.
Bell is cleared to practice and played in the preseason finale but is still working on conditioning after ACL surgery rehabilitation.
Coleman returned from an undisclosed injury to play in the preseason game but is currently behind multiple receivers on the depth chart.
Thompson returned to practice in a non-contact jersey after missing Saturday's session due to an undisclosed injury, indicating a minor issue being managed during the preseason.
Connor Hulstein was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will need to reach an injury settlement with the Jets to have a chance to play in 2026.
